Legacy command intent:

ViewBS MethLevDist --sample data/test_data/test_WT.tab.gz,WT --regions regions.bed --outdir out --prefix dist_regions --minDepth 1 --maxDepth 100 --binMethLev 0.5

Expected output provenance:

The local legacy Perl entrypoint cannot be executed in this environment because Getopt::Long::Subcommand is not installed. This fixture uses the checked-in indexed methylation fixture data/test_data/test_WT.tab.gz and follows the checked-in legacy implementation in lib/Meth/LevDist.pm:

- query regions from regions.bed;
- compute weighted region methylation levels;
- bin region-level methylation by --binMethLev;
- preserve midpoint labels and integer percentage formatting.
